description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger queries. Should-trigger covers DE + EN phrasings for client-side insecure-render / client-trust patterns (XSS, client secrets, client-only auth, CORS, localStorage tokens). Should-not-trigger covers near-miss neighbours (server-side security, generic checklist, accessibility-only, dependency intake) whose vocabulary overlaps.
